messages:
maria: Quick brainstorm on safer v1 deprecation fanout. Goal: avoid noisy dashboards and sudden routing flips. Thinking 3-stage: probe -> notice -> enforce. Opinions?

aj: +1. How do those stages map to routing/quotas and console visibility?

kevin: Sketch: probe = sampled telemetry only (non-billing tags), notice = console banners + metrics (no routing change), enforce = routing/quota changes but with soft eviction TTL and tenant opt-out.

sarah: Telemetry details: emit labels {api_version, deprec_stage, deprec_sample, route_bucket}. Important: bucket routes to limit cardinality, only attach real route_bucket when route >1% tenant traffic.

aj: Rollout idea: feature flag `deprec_fanout_v1` off by default. Phase A: probe at 1% internal. Phase B: probe 10% + notice in console for beta tenants. Phase C: enforce for small cohort then widen.

kevin: Guardrails: auto-disable enforce for a tenant if error-rate > baseline+1% or p95 latency increases >30ms over 30m. Also audit opt-outs.

maria: Console UX: probe = subtle info pill, notice = banner with impacted endpoints link, enforce = warning with "defer 24h" and support opt-out button. Will draft copy.

sarah: I'll open two PRs today: (1) telemetry instrumentation + route bucketing util, (2) console banners + per-tenant impact page stub.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `feature/deprec-fanout-v1` -> staging 2026-03-24T06:00Z

aj: I'll own the feature flag rollout doc and rollback playbook.

maria: Great. I'll file the RFC linking Sarah's PRs and Aj's rollout plan. No objections?

kevin: No objections.

sarah: PRs coming shortly.
